scope: Minimal mapped reset-ownership fixture, not full PS/GT runtime
assertions: Control-reset assertion asynchronously holds target reset
Target reset remains asserted after external reset release while control stopped
Coordinator reset set is observed before control-reset deassertion
No low retained-request interval during ownership handover
Target release requires resumed target-clock edges
mutation_controls: Coordinator CE tied0 must fail handover check
OR LUT replaced by AND must fail stopped-control retention
limits: Digital zero-delay vendor models only; no physical timing qualification
